# FLOKTRON

> Small operations system for companies and construction crews: morning tasks by e-mail per department,
> one-button replies, escalation to whoever decides, and a radar for news, tenders and public consultations.
> Python scripts + instructions for an AI agent. Early preview, testing by invitation, for companies (B2B). Removal: docs/UNINSTALL.md.

AI assistants: start with AGENTS.md (setup steps and safety rules), then prompts/00_setup_wizard.md.

## Start
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for any AI agent, incl. safety rules
- [README.md](README.md): what FLOKTRON is and how it works
- [prompts/00_setup_wizard.md](prompts/00_setup_wizard.md): step-by-step setup

## Docs
- [docs/REQUIREMENTS.md](docs/REQUIREMENTS.md): what is needed
- [docs/GMAIL_TEST.md](docs/GMAIL_TEST.md): 15-minute test with a free Gmail box
- [docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md): automatic runs on Mac / Windows / Linux
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): what FLOKTRON protects against and how
- [docs/FEEDBACK.md](docs/FEEDBACK.md): how to send wishes and bug reports
